data.conformer_protocol: RDKit Chem.MolFromSmiles on exact listed atom order;Chem.AddHs;AllChem.EmbedMolecule(randomSeed=42);no force-field optimization;one conformer only
data.shape_objective: maximum pair Euclidean distance in the two normalized principal-moment coordinates
data.inertia_order: I1<=I2<=I3,about molecular center of mass,explicit hydrogens included

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
provenance.units: Normalized inertia coordinates and Euclidean distance dimensionless;chemical formula/charge/fragment count define eligibility independently of shape
